selectedSource.title: Forest Tenure Harvesting Authority Polygons
selectedSource.reason: The catalogue's only downloadable distribution is a custom order with no stable artifact URL. The live service is mutable and supplies neither a publisher edition nor version marker, so it cannot be represented as a complete immutable snapshot without a bounded custom export and readback. Re-measured on 2026-08-30, the case is stronger than first recorded: the serviceCount above is a property of the ArcGIS delivery endpoint, not of the dataset. BC's own WFS reports 71869 features for the same feature class on the same day, against 46833 here, and the ArcGIS figure has not moved since 2026-08-14. The difference runs in both directions by lifecycle, so neither endpoint is a subset of the other, and BC states an as-of time for neither. See data/bc-ften-endpoint-divergence-2026-08-30.json.

endpointComparison.note: Recorded so that any argument resting on a feature count says which endpoint produced it. Which endpoint is authoritative, and when either was refreshed, are publisher facts that BC does not state and that this repository does not infer.

operationalSemantics.purpose: Harvesting authority is a legal cleared area; it is not proof that harvest occurred.
operationalSemantics.restriction: No status may be normalized as completed harvest without a separately reviewed lifecycle mapping.

accessRequestDraft: Please provide or confirm a reproducible BC Geographic Warehouse export for WHSE_FOREST_TENURE.FTEN_HARVEST_AUTH_POLY_SVW, including an as-of timestamp or publisher edition/version, full feature count, CRS, field schema, output format, checksum and required attribution. We will retain the raw file, preserve Open Government Licence - British Columbia attribution, and will not infer completed harvest from PENDING, ACTIVE, or RETIRED without an approved lifecycle mapping.
